content.value_statement: AI client setup often fails because tools expect different base URL and protocol formats. This skill selects the correct RouteMux endpoint and verifies access.
actual_capabilities: Provides the RouteMux gateway URL and authorization header format.
Maps OpenAI, Anthropic, and Vertex-compatible clients to supported API paths.
Explains when a client needs the base URL with or without the v1 path.
Verifies credentials and connectivity through the models endpoint.
Directs users to maintained integration guides for specific clients.
limitations: Requires an existing RouteMux API key for authenticated verification.
Does not contain complete configuration blocks for every supported client.
Cannot restore vendor features that bypass a configured third-party gateway.
Depends on external RouteMux documentation remaining current and available.

use_cases.title: Configure a Coding Agent
use_cases.description: Select the correct RouteMux base URL and protocol for a command-line coding assistant.

use_cases.title: Connect a Chat Client
use_cases.description: Match a desktop chat application with a compatible RouteMux API surface.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Gateway Errors
use_cases.description: Distinguish authentication failures from incorrect API paths and base URL formats.

prompt_templates.title: Find the Base URL
prompt_templates.prompt: Give me the RouteMux base URL and explain whether my client should include the v1 path.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs the essential connection values.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a Client
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me connect [client name] to RouteMux. Use the maintained integration guide and identify the required protocol.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs client-specific setup guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot an Error
prompt_templates.prompt: My RouteMux request returns [status code]. Diagnose the likely key, path, or protocol problem and suggest a verification step.
prompt_templates.scenario: A configured client cannot complete requests.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Multiple Integrations
prompt_templates.prompt: Review RouteMux settings for [client list]. Compare protocols, base URL forms, verification results, and unsupported vendor features.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user manages several AI clients.

output_examples.input: Which endpoint should an Anthropic-compatible client use?
output_examples.output: Use the Anthropic-compatible Messages surface at the RouteMux gateway. Confirm whether the client appends the messages path automatically.

output_examples.input: My client returns 404 after switching to RouteMux.
output_examples.output: Try the alternate base URL form first. The client may expect the v1 segment itself or may append it automatically.

output_examples.input: How do I know whether my key works?
output_examples.output: Run an authenticated models request after confirming the destination. A model list indicates valid credentials and a reachable base URL.

best_practices: Confirm the client protocol before choosing an endpoint.
Check both base URL forms when a configured client returns 404.
Use current RouteMux integration documentation for client-specific settings.
anti_patterns: Do not expose the API key in replies, logs, or unrequested configuration files.
Do not declare success without an authenticated verification request.
Do not assume built-in image or audio features use the configured gateway.

faq.question: What is the RouteMux gateway address?
faq.answer: The documented gateway base URL is https://api.routemux.com.

faq.question: Do all clients use the same base URL format?
faq.answer: No. Some clients need the v1 segment, while others append it automatically.

faq.question: Which protocols does RouteMux support here?
faq.answer: The skill documents OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-compatible, and Vertex-compatible API surfaces.

faq.question: What does a 401 response mean?
faq.answer: A 401 response usually indicates an invalid, missing, or rejected API key.

faq.question: What does a 404 response mean?
faq.answer: A 404 response usually indicates an incorrect path or base URL form.

faq.question: Will built-in image features work through RouteMux?
faq.answer: Not always. Vendor-managed features may ignore the configured gateway and require a separate HTTP integration.
